title: Araghchi: The recent war in our region showed the countries of the region that the presence of American bases did not contribute to their security in any way; rather, it undermined their security. These bases not only failed to defend the host countries but could not even defend themselves. All of them suffered heavy blows and were destroyed in the recent war.
text:
Araghchi: The recent war in our region showed the countries of the region that the presence of American bases did not contribute to their security in any way; rather, it undermined their security. These bases not only failed to defend the host countries but could not even defend themselves. All of them suffered heavy blows and were destroyed in the recent war."

"We welcome any initiative that leads to endogenous and collective security for the countries of the region without the presence of foreign forces, and we consider it the correct path.
